method.distributions: empirical outcome ratios from 2025 weekly actuals, tiered by position and projection level
method.correlation: Gaussian copula on measured 2025 correlations (QB-WR +0.30, QB-oppDEF -0.34, DEF-K +0.25)
method.availability: lineup-state enumeration: every in/out combination is re-solved with the best legal bench replacement promoted, then drawn in proportion to its probability
method.play_rates: fitted from 1,831 fantasy-position player-weeks joining the 2025 official NFL injury report to Sleeper's gp flag
method.scoring: league settings, not Sleeper's stock pts_ppr
method.scoring_note: skill positions match Sleeper default within 0.1 pt; K is -0.3 on average; DEF is -2.3 and reorders, with the good-to-bad spread 58% wider than stock
method.floor_ceiling: 10th and 90th percentile of the simulated team total. Two variants are reported: 'as it stands' includes each tagged player's chance of sitting and the historical chance of leaving a game early; 'if everyone plays' forces all play probabilities to 1.0 and draws from outcome pools censored of early-exit games (snap share below half the player's own median).

censoring.rule: drop weeks whose last offensive snap was in Q1 or Q2 for every-down players; keep Q3/Q4/OT exits

method.outcome_band_basis: measured on 14,532 player-weeks 2023-25; +-24% of projection covers only 27.8% of weeks (bust 39.9%, boom 32.2%), so 24% is the smallest bucket not the dominant one. +-45% is where 'neither' first clears 50% league-wide.
